title: Adoption notes and the patch release
goal: Projects can adopt publish hooks from a tagged release
acceptance: docs/apply/built-views.md and pull-requests.md describe the hook; CHANGELOG entry; patch tag after the merge with green CI on main
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: A change that makes a coordinator edit its own files is a major release; ask first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 at agent speed; not a measurement.
